prompts.name: BimSectionBox
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single production Navisworks ribbon toolbar icon for the company-neutral BIM Tools plugin. Design a bold, exceptionally simple, premium engineering software pictogram. Square image with a truly transparent background. Compact centered composition fills 82% of the canvas; large solid shapes, few details, clean sharp edges, no hairline strokes. Slight isometric view, flat vector-like illustration with three blue tonal faces. Palette cobalt blue #1769D2, deep navy #123D73, pale cyan #B7E4FF. Must remain readable at 16 and 32 pixels. No letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark, no background tile, no drop shadow, no green. Subject: one cobalt blue solid cube intersected by a single pale cyan horizontal cutting plane, with four strong deep blue corner brackets suggesting a cropping section box. The cube and cutting plane form one bold silhouette. Avoid intricate wireframes or grids.
